Officials Urge Corporate India to Boost Salaries and Hiring

Following tax relief measures, Indian officials have called on corporate India to increase employee salaries and enhance hiring. Department of Economic Affairs (DEA) Secretary Anuradha Thakur noted a stagnation of wages and urged companies to address this. The Secretary for the Department of Investment and Public Asset Management (DIPAM) also called for greater long-term capital beyond traditional bank lending.
